resources.string: PolarisECG needs a few permissions to record your ECG reliably, even overnight with the screen off. Nothing leaves your phone.
Needed to find your Polar H10 strap and connect to it. It is not used to determine your location.
Android requires a visible notification while recording runs in the background. It also shows connection status.
Without this Android may stop the recording during the night. You may also need to set Battery to \"Unrestricted\" for this app in system settings.
Wear the strap with moist electrodes so it wakes up, and close Polar Flow / Polar Beat first.
No H10 found yet. Check that the strap is worn and moist, then scan again.
